args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site has a clean, simple design, which is great for easy navigation. However, it's currently quite minimal — it only contains a short introduction and your email address. I'd suggest adding more content, such as a section about who you are, your background, your projects or work, and maybe some interests or hobbies. Including a bit more personality and detail would make the site more engaging and give visitors a better sense of who you are. Also, consider adding a contact form or links to your social profiles alongside your email. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog highlights your favorite hobby — hiking! It's always great to see people sharing their passions. To make the blog even better, I'd suggest adding more content such as posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, gear recommendations, or photos from your adventures. A few trail guides or personal stories would really bring the blog to life and give readers something to connect with. Overall, it's a nice start — keep exploring and sharing your hikes!
